proof.source: A=1 cheaper actual seed. B_tau=exp(-tau[h_IC,P_seed]) U_seed on WHOLE4V space; wedge of its2V occupied columns in each of64 copies over ONE common Haar field. Exact unitary and canonical norm1 pointwise imply exact joint norm1. Smooth periodic matrix exponential has every PH order, no PH truncation or finite Fourier cut. Tau varies the wave only.
proof.first_variation: S=[h_IC,P]; dot P=-[S,P]. h_IC has only distinct-cell blocks while P,U_seed and every field derivative of the seed are cell diagonal. Q h_IC P is exactly in sectors with one cell losing and another gaining one particle. Hence onsite/intracell matter, HE/HC acting on the seed and their inner products with dotPsi vanish by actual fixed cell-number orthogonality. Tr h_IC dotP=-2||Q h_IC P||HS^2; active1+aux63 share identical h_IC but different onsite masses. Electric tangent connection r1=i U_seed^dag S_e_prime U_seed is off-cell; r0 and P0 are cell diagonal, so Tr P0 r1=Tr P0 r0 Q0 r1=0. No C/parity argument is needed.
proof.uniform_lower: Select adjacent z-plane cell pairs. Both directed cell transitions are distinct for every evenN>=4, and no length2 z path has the same endpoints. For A0=Q_onsite h_ab P_onsite, ||A0||HS=sqrt(8 ci_z^2 gs). Seed ||P-Ponsite||<=8t gives ||A-A0||HS<=64t sqrt(c0_z^2 g0+ci_z^2 gs). Hence 64||Q h_IC P||HS^2 >=32V b^2, with b the positive bracket. Uniform Haar derivative <=-64V b^2.
proof.curvature_matter: Let B=2sum_paths(|c0|sqrt(g0)+|ci|sqrt(gs)). The row/column Schur bound on native forward/reverse blocks gives ||h_IC||<=B, including AP/two-link collisions. Off-diagonal P/Q form of S implies ||S||<=B. P_tau double commutator has trace norm <=4B^2 rankP=8VB^2. Thus each role Taylor remainder <=4V H_role B^2 tau^2; H_role=|onsite_role|sqrt(g0)+B. No role averaging.
proof.local_trace_derivative: Each edge occurs in one length1 and two length2 paths, with reverse included. ||h_IC,e prime||1<=8(a1+2a2). Seed ||P_e prime||1<=16 sin(t), so ||S_e prime||1<=D=16(a1+2a2)+32B sin(t), uniformly N and field; use max axis. Integral Duhamel, unitarity and trace-norm ideal property give ||R_tau,e-R_0,e||1<=|tau|D and ||R_tau,e-R_0,e-tau r1,e||1<=tau^2 B D. Derivative rank may spread; NO finite-rank assumption on exponential derivative.
proof.curvature_electric: A=1 seed r0 has operator norm <=sin(t) on itsV active edges and0 on others. Orthogonality kills the linear Wick variation, including Berry crosscopy variation even without assuming seed mean0. Exact seed mean0 is separately inherited from the actual gate Clifford trace proof in the frozen input; linear Berry mean0 follows distinct-cell sectors. Per edge Var delta <=tau^2(2 sin(t) B D+D^2), and |mu_tau|<=tau^2 BD. ALL64 same-field Wick terms are 64 Var+64^2 mu^2. On Gauss sector COMPLETE HE64+HC64=64sum_3V Efull^2, so delta/V <=192[64(2sBD+D^2)tau^2+4096B^2D^2tau^4]. Full Ref4 stays fixed, rho=sum64(n-2), neutral exact AP sea unchanged. This prices longitudinal HC, not transverse-only HE.
proof.rational_enclosure: Pinned exact saved g rationals are checked in [1/10,11/100] for gs and [0,3/10] for g0. sqrt(gs)>=3/10, <=1/3; sqrt(g0)<=11/20; sqrt(8)>=14/5; sin(1/128)<=1/128. b>= (21/25)|ci_z|-(11/40)|c0_z|-|ci_z|/6. All bound arithmetic is exact Fraction, with no finite-float positivity certificate.
proof.complete_action: The curvature proof is an N-uniform complete-H energy decrease proof, not an actual variance or PHP squared. Additionally per edge second derivative of B_tau has trace norm <=8s+16s|tau|D+|tau|D2+tau^2D^2. Here D2=16(a1+2a2)+64s(a1+2a2)+32B s+64B s^2 bounds S_e second derivative by differentiating both commutators. Exterior second derivative on64 copies bounded by64 b2+64^2 b1^2 with b1=8s+|tau|D. Hence ||HE+HC Psi||<=192V(64b2+4096b1^2), using full covariant edge derivatives. Matter action <=2Vsum load H_role. Neutral eigenenergy is subtracted exactly. The triangle bounds the COMPLETE body action; actual full-H variance remains uncomputed.
